desc:
Start your own delivery company and become the best delivery driver in town!

Pick a company name and logo, grab your branded van and get to work. Load every package by hand at the parcel hub, follow the GPS and deliver to every door on time.

- Run your own courier company with your own name and logo
- Load your van by hand while forklifts bring the pallets
- Drive through living towns with traffic lights, crosswalks and people
- Earn stars, on-time bonuses and perfect delivery rewards
- Grow your reputation, rank up and unlock bigger vans
- Daily goals and streaks for extra rewards
- Explore new towns, country roads and the big suspension bridge
- Day and night cycle, pick-up jobs and leaderboards
- Play with friends: every player runs their own company

UPDATE 1 LOG 📜
-2 New Towns 
-Map Expansion
-First Person Driving

Drive with WASD, a controller or the touch pedals. Works on PC, phone, tablet and console.

Coming soon: build your own depot, hire workers and grow your fleet!
